moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-stretch-rise, written here): Split chars, pivot top centre; each char from y +120 % (1.2 em), scaleY 2.3, scaleX 0.7 → 0, 1, 1, opacity full by 60 % (×1.6), 0.9 s back.inOut(2) (CSS cubic-bezier(.68,−.6,.32,1.6)); stagger 30 ms (demo 50 ms capped 0.7 s), from 0.3 s; chars hidden below a floor just under the baseline. The overshoot reads as a brief squash (scaleY < 1). Loop exit: fade 2.65–2.95 s; loop 3 s. Params: duration (0.9 s) · stagger (0.03 s) · scaleY / scaleX đầu (2.3 / 0.7) · y (120 %) · ease (back.inOut(2)). Pivot at the top; letters are hidden below a floor at the word's bottom edge, and the overshoot reads as a brief squash.
